name: Matsuoka Chie
source:
Chie lives in Fukuoka (福岡), Fukuoka and goes to Kokuyoukan High School (黒曜館高校) where she is a third year student in class C.

She likes rock music, and is the singer for a rock band. She also plays the guitar.
